reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing isMonthFillTarget/getMonthFillCategories selection that every month-wide action already uses.

duplication.why: The hidden rule override lives once in isMonthFillTarget; only the unavoidable per-action parameter plumbing is repeated across the six actions.

placement.why: The override sits in the shared selection predicate in budget/actions.ts, after the template, #fixed and income exclusions it must not lift.

scope.why: Only the actions, the predicate, tests and a release note are changed.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; a boolean that silently overrides the existing scope parameter is a little less explicit than adding an 'all' scope value.
